Below it a centred block of headings: the work title INSTITVTIONIS, DIALECTICAE, LIBER IIII., a fleuron, a subtitle in italic, and CAP. I. One column of running text below, opening with a large woodcut initial. No margin notes. Catchword "De" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.l: INSTITVTIONIS DIALECTICAE LIBER IIII.
CAP. I.
QUONIAM de inuetione Me-
dij Syllogistici satis dixisti, de-
inceps de ipsius collocatione
videamus: quam iudicandi ar-
tem superius Analyticen appellabas.
Sed primum quæro, quid est Analytice?
Est ars, quæ medij ad utrunque quæstionis
extremum adhibendi rationem common-
strat.
Quisnam eius artis est usus? Probatio cō-
secutionis, qua pronuntiata omnia vel ut vera
recipiuntur, vel ut falsa repudiantur. Nam ut
in ædificiis, alius est faber, qui lapides lapidibus
adiungit: alius peritus, cuius arbitrio effectum
opus probatur: sic oratio verba verbis
adiungit: sed Analyticæ artis probatio est,
utrum ea inter se rectè coniuncta sint, an se-
cus.

page.notes: The large initial is an ornamental woodcut letter read as Q; the initial is joined to "UONIAM" in the transcription. Long s is rendered as s throughout. Printed "vt", "vsus", "vel" and "vera" were corrected to ut, usus, vel and vera per the u/v rule. The line "De Analytice,siue" has no space after the comma in print. The catchword "De" is printed at the lower right. No running head, since the page opens a new division.
